assets.name: bench
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one original documentary editorial photograph for fictional Helixward Assay Services, a small Cambridge Massachusetts research-only laboratory. Landscape 4:3. Close wide view of a clean ordinary laboratory bench in soft cool daylight: a transparent rectangular microplate with an orderly 8 by 12 grid of small circular wells is closed and resting flat at a slight diagonal, a blue plastic rack of capped empty sample tubes sits behind it, and a plain compact white plate-reader instrument is partly visible further back. Accurate ordinary proportions, no glowing particles or dramatic science-fiction. Off-white worktop with subtle real texture, muted teal-blue equipment accents, softly out-of-focus glass partition and daylight lab behind. No active experiment, liquid dispensing, cultures, blood, body tissue or procedural setup. No text, labels, logos, manufacturer marks, certificates, data, hands or people. Photographic material detail: transparent plastic edge and light reflections, familiar modest research workspace, naturally imperfect documentary composition. Hero image for a website about carefully scoped assay studies and traceable reports. Fully fictional original image.
